subject: A panoramic community greenhouse project: neighbors tend seedlings, builders repair its roof, and water channels feed the crops
prompt:
USER SUBJECT: A panoramic community greenhouse project: neighbors tend seedlings, builders repair its roof, and water channels feed the crops
Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: fresco_mural
REPRESENTATION: stylized
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [connected-narrative-registers] Group the requested activities into a few connected registers; use changes in scale, direction, and adjacency to lead the eye between them while maintaining one continuous spatial world.
- [shared-scale-people-and-systems] Make people, equipment, materials, and surrounding structures occupy a coherent shared scale; show their relation through clear contact, alignment, or repeated structural rhythms instead of isolating a heroic figure from the scene.
- [flat-contour-and-fresco-color-planes] Establish large forms with clear contours and broad overlapping color planes; use restrained surface variation to suggest painted plaster, and let color relationships clarify groups instead of modeling every object with realistic gradients.
- [narrative-scale-surface-coherence] Let register sequence, shared scale, and flat color planes make the user's public narrative readable as one mural.
REQUIREMENT: Declare the public-narrative-mural context before applying this direction.
REQUIREMENT: Preserve the user's requested people, activities, and setting.
REQUIREMENT: Use connected registers only when the brief contains multiple requested activities.
REQUIREMENT: Keep contour, color plane, and scale hierarchy readable at a distance.

scope.description: A mural-scale narrative direction that links several requested activities through broad registers, monumental but readable forms, and shared scale
limitations: Preserve the user-requested people, activities, setting, and relationships; do not add workers, factories, machinery, national symbols, or political emblems unless requested.
Use multiple registers only when the brief contains multiple activities or a broad public narrative; do not split a single action into a forced timeline.
Keep large shapes readable at a distance while retaining enough local detail to distinguish the requested actions.

rules.applies_when: The prompt requests a broad mural narrative with more than one activity or stage.
rules.instruction: Group the requested activities into a few connected registers; use changes in scale, direction, and adjacency to lead the eye between them while maintaining one continuous spatial world.
rules.observable: Each requested activity can be located at a glance, and the registers connect as a single mural rather than separate unrelated vignettes.
rules.reject_when: The composition becomes an arbitrary grid, duplicates the same event, or omits a requested activity.
rules.avoid: unrelated comic-strip panels and invented narrative episodes

rules.applies_when: The brief includes people working with tools, structures, or natural systems.
rules.instruction: Make people, equipment, materials, and surrounding structures occupy a coherent shared scale; show their relation through clear contact, alignment, or repeated structural rhythms instead of isolating a heroic figure from the scene.
rules.observable: A viewer can understand how the requested people interact with their environment, and no single scale mismatch breaks the mural's spatial logic.
rules.reject_when: Figures float above their work, tools become unrelated decoration, or machinery overwhelms the requested human activity.
rules.avoid: isolated hero figures, unrequested machines, and scale jumps without narrative purpose

rules.applies_when: The image is intended to read as a large painted mural.
rules.instruction: Establish large forms with clear contours and broad overlapping color planes; use restrained surface variation to suggest painted plaster, and let color relationships clarify groups instead of modeling every object with realistic gradients.
rules.observable: The scene remains legible from a distance, while adjacent people, structures, and materials keep distinct color identities.
rules.reject_when: The surface becomes a photorealistic depth render, a global color filter, or an ornate texture that obscures the narrative.
rules.avoid: photorealistic volume, decorative pseudo-fresco cracking, and global color tint

joint_checks.instruction: Let register sequence, shared scale, and flat color planes make the user's public narrative readable as one mural.
joint_checks.observable: Requested activities connect across a coherent wall-sized composition, with people and environment clearly related and no decorative motifs substituted for content.
